incidents.name: UN token price manipulation
incidents.notes: The UN token sizes its internal buy-back/reward from the UN/USDT pair's live reserves, so a flash loan moved that price and let the attacker extract the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: UN 0x1aFA48B74bA7aC0C3C5A2c8B7E24eB71D440846F created 2023-05-30T07:44:11Z by 0x797d22e9fa8f707ba061b79f278f3bdf61015d31, unrelated to attack sender 0xf84efa8a9f7e68855cf17eaac9c2f97a9d131366; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 26,558.71 USDT left the UN pair 0x5F739a4AdE4341D4AEe049E679095BcCbe904Ee1 to the attacker. Boundary row: the token behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
